result.topic_en: Riemann's lecture announcement (Latin, with German version) for a course on functions of a complex variable, especially the hypergeometric series and related transcendents, together with the hypergeometric differential equation written in logarithmic form.
result.transcription:
Bernhardus Riemann, Dr. Functiones complexae quantitatis variabilis tractabit, imprimis evolutiones in series hypergeometricas aliasque earum transcendentes, quaternis scholis h. X–XI.
[-Dr-] [-Riemann-] [-wird-] Über Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe [-..-] insbesondere über hypergeometrische Reihen und verwandte Transcendenten, vierma[l] wöchentlich, 10–11 Uhr.

$(1-x)\frac{d^2y}{d\log x^2} - (\alpha+\alpha' + (\beta+\beta')x)\frac{dy}{d\log x} + (\alpha\alpha' - \beta\beta' x)y = 0$

methods.what: Hypergeometric (Riemann-type) second-order differential equation written with respect to log x, with exponents α, α' at 0 and β, β' at ∞

items.quote: Bernhardus Riemann, Dr. Functiones complexae quantitatis variabilis tractabit, imprimis evolutiones in series hypergeometricas aliasque earum transcendentes, quaternis scholis h. X–XI.
items.english: Dr. Bernhard Riemann will treat functions of a complex variable quantity, especially expansions in hypergeometric series and other transcendents of that kind, in four lectures [weekly] at 10–11.
